text: ROLO (ROLO Pastelaria) is the own brand of Grupo Rolo, a Portuguese industrial pastry and confectionery group founded in 1995, based at Óbidos; the group's site says it launched the ROLO brand in October 2025 and describes the group as a family business.
short: ROLO Pastelaria is the brand of Grupo Rolo, a Portuguese family pastry group founded in 1995.

source.name: Grupo Rolo: Sobre o Grupo (gruporolo.com/sobre-nos)
source.quote: Em outubro de 2025, apresentámos a nova identidade do Grupo Rolo e lançámos a marca ROLO
source.note: Same page: 'O Grupo Rolo foi fundado em 1995' with nine industrial units in Mafra, Óbidos and Alcobaça, 'preservando a essência de empresa familiar'; footer contact: Zona Industrial das Gaeiras, 2510-752 Gaeiras, Óbidos. The owning family is not named. Undated page.
